title: How to Add a Video in a Sidebar
text:
## How to Add a Video in a Sidebar
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000033973
This article describes the steps necessary for adding a video to any website sidebar.
For this example, the site is a Real Estate/Property site, and the video we will add is of a house. The video we are adding is to promote a new house, recently put on the market.
This can be used to sell promotional ad space for existing profiles and external companies.
Results:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079594453/original/XNpfmBLGOjahSPyRMaKfDwMNJr27DoxMwQ.png?1594043032 | alt: ]

## Step 1 - Create A New Widget:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093126657/original/u5Mgbwnhq323_SwNYcF-dMZbWmNRlhVDLQ.png?1621958008 | alt: ]
In the HTML tab, add the EMBED code for the video below the "<div style=...>":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079594780/original/26Qc8C_OPj2f8CwpVsbZ_7huHcs0mLp42w.png?1594043376 | alt: ]
It is also possible to add text and links to the sidebar:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079595518/original/ZtpZY01RzHg8DpuB8SW8thVtqiUXMPa5Lg.png?1594044046 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079594880/original/C_emdJLDm6OEeGtFc1D6bUtbsGvmqPRU1A.png?1594043486 | alt: ]
Additional Information:
» Toolbox » Widget Manager

## Step 2 - Find the Sidebar to Display the New Video Widget
Go to Toolbox » Sidebar Manager » Select the Sidebar, click Edit or Customize :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093126792/original/0QKJQw3gF3yXrlnpANAUCOnaVvxd46UMhw.png?1621958125 | alt: ]
For this example, we are using the Posts Search Result Sidebar. Inside the Sidebar, find the name of the new widget and drag-and-drop the widget:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095917127/original/ihS-5yobIjFjIG-DtzsbJfVMihCBFTXX4Q.png?1627064515 | alt: ]
Now click on Save Changes .
